Cloud Operations

Khuyến nghị tối ưu hóa tài nguyên

An automated or expert-driven suggestion to adjust resource allocation (up or down) to optimize cloud cost and performance according to observed workload patterns.

Definition

An automated or expert-driven suggestion to adjust resource allocation (up or down) to optimize cloud cost and performance according to observed workload patterns.

Operational example

A rightsizing recommendation was issued to downsize over-provisioned compute instances in production.
